note_text:
CC: hallux MTP pain with new midfoot stiffness

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to painful plantar callus. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with painful plantar callus. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Paring of single hyperkeratotic lesion performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
